title: Ask the AI, it acts: driving real devices from a chat with VirtualPyTest
description:
Plain English in, tool calls out. VirtualPyTest ships an AI agent backed by a built-in MCP server that exposes the whole platform: docs, scripts, devices and the screen itself.

In this video, four requests in one chat, recorded live on a real host:
1. "Show device status": every device in the fleet, in seconds.
2. A question about the freeze detector: the agent searches the docs, reads them and answers with the threshold and where it lives.
3. "Run the goto script to video_player on youtube-web": it picks the device, the script and the parameters, runs it and comes back with the report link.
4. "Open YouTube, search Raspberry Pi and give me the first result": no script this time. It works the browser itself and answers with the exact title.

Every tool call is visible in the transcript. The same tools are available to any MCP client: Claude, Cursor or your own agent.
